status: PARTIAL — V2 non pronta per deploy

source_of_truth.reason: Accesso diretto ai file del sandbox Base44 non disponibile nel piano workspace

verified_discrepancies.finding: The current Base44 editor build is not proven identical to the static website in GitHub main.
verified_discrepancies.resolution: Obtain full Base44 source export before copying into V2.

verified_discrepancies.finding: Base44 has entities Album, NewsArticle, BiographyChapter, GalleryItem and User; GitHub repository reviewed is HTML/CSS/JS without verified migration of these resources.
verified_discrepancies.resolution: Export schemas/data/functions/automations and document Base44-only dependencies.

verified_discrepancies.finding: Netlify production deploy is upload/drop sourced, has no commit_ref and has_source_zip=false; Git-connected automatic deployments not verified.
verified_discrepancies.resolution: Set up Git connection only for isolated V2 after source export.

verified_discrepancies.finding: GitHub static homepage HTML contains __bundler_thumbnail and __bundler_loading placeholder markup. Entire document contains embedded __bundler templates, so this alone is not proof of a broken render.
verified_discrepancies.resolution: Browser smoke test and runtime validation needed.

verified_discrepancies.finding: Static homepage canonical and JSON-LD identify GitHub Pages as canonical; robots/sitemap also point to GitHub Pages while Netlify production uses www.assemblage23.it.
verified_discrepancies.resolution: Review hostname-specific canonical, robots and sitemap; do so in V2 first.

verified_discrepancies.finding: 404 page points to the GitHub Pages homepage; internal links need host-aware validation.
verified_discrepancies.resolution: Run internal link checks against the V2 host.

verified_discrepancies.finding: Netlify V2 project created but no published deploy, and no GitHub V2 repository found.
verified_discrepancies.resolution: Import only verified Base44 source, create or connect dedicated repository, then deploy preview.

next_steps: Export actual Base44 application source from editor or by CLI with authenticated local access.
Inventory files, assets, entity schemas and exported records; exclude secrets.
Create dedicated GitHub V2 repository and push exact exported source.
Connect only the V2 Netlify project to the V2 repository.
Verify build, visual fidelity, links, canonical/robots/sitemap, 404, responsive behavior, accessibility.
Publish V2 as protected preview, compare with Base44, then ask for approval before production changes.
